column1: # The productive template in src/swa.rs handles the regular verb (the
# open class), the monosyllabic ku-retention (detected by a one-vowel
# stem), the Arabic loans (detected by a non-a final vowel) and the
# vowel-initial stems (concord coalescence). What is left is stored here:
# the suppletive -enda/-ja and any stem that breaks the vowel-count rule.
# Columns (a `-` cell falls through to the rule):
#   lemma  mono  inf  long_stem  short_stem  subj_stem  imp_sg  imp_pl
#     mono       1/0 override of the one-vowel ku-retention test
#  subjunctive -ende (twende) and imperative (nenda); the a-tense keeps
#  the bare stem (aenda). -ja "come": regular except its imperative
